PIN NUMBER DAY!!!!! 🎉🎉🎉

I am sitting in clinic trying to type this and my hands are shaking haha, but I HAVE to post it now before I burst!!

@Lorna Villaruz — LORNAAA VILLARUZ — my friend since 1996, my sister from another mother, my forever partner in crime — her NMC PIN came through!!! She is officially a registered nurse in the UK!!! 🙏

After two years of papers, IELTS, CBT and OSCE (Nottingham, remember? I sent you that photo of the rain so you knew what you were getting into!), she did it. And for those of you who don't know her: 1996, Iloilo nursing school, our capping ceremony — same hairstyle, same dream, and those white shoes we polished every single night before bed. Lorna, you STILL never bought your own polish, you always borrowed mine! 😂

Then Riyadh, then Dubai — almost 18 years of night shifts, long flights and missing home. And all that time I was badgering her: come to England, come to Liverpool, come and work with me. Twenty years of me telling her to come and she finally listened haha. Actually, she is the one who cried at the airport in 2004 — "susunod ako, I will follow you" — and look at her now. 22 years later, here she is!! I cried reading her message, Charing, right there in the clinic 😭

Her flight lands 14 January, Dubai to Manchester, around 1pm. So yes, I will be the one pacing around arrivals with a coat ready, because this wind is not for joking with.

And she starts 25 January — Ward 7, medical, Mersey Bank Hospital. Induction first, then her preceptorship. Ward 7 does not know how lucky it is. She is the best nurse I know — the calmest, steadiest hands, patients just love her, she makes a hard shift feel easy.

Good news: she is staying with US for the first month!! Spare room is being cleared, thick duvet on the bed, heater on full blast because she will freeze. Ben already said yes (he has been told to clear space in the garage for the Bicol pili and the dried mangoes ha 😂).

Lorna, listen to me. Bring a PROPER coat. Not the Divisoria one — TK Maxx or Primark, I will come with you if I have to. Liverpool wind in January is no joke, and you do not want to find out on day one. Bring your scrubs, your comfortable shoes, your laugh — Ward 7 needs that one.

Welcome, my friend. Welcome to Liverpool, and welcome to our Filipino family here — the Christmas parties (all of them, potluck and pancit chaos included), and Simbang Gabi next year with us, nine nights of dawn masses and singing 🎶, and the cold we will all complain about while still eating together.

Twenty years, Charing. You followed. You came. And I have never been prouder, or happier, to have you home. ❤️

Tito Ben says hello. Andrea says hi from Manchester and is claiming her old room ha.

Now eat something, rest, and get that flight booked. See you on the 14th!!!

Mahal kita, Charing. Welcome home. 🎉🤍
